item.title: Supply chain attack on arrayref
item.description: What happened On 2026-08-20 at 7:15 UTC we got a report that the proc-macro1 crate was malicious. The Rust Security Response Team verified this to be the case: the crate had a build script that was downloading a malicious payload. (3 sources: lobsters, rprogramming, rustblog)

item.title: Malicious Rust crate Arrayref runs a build-time payload
item.description: A compromised release of the popular Rust crate arrayref pulled in a typosquatted proc-macro1 whose build script downloads and runs a remote binary at compile… (1 source: hackernews)
